## Directions 

Each chapter assignment consists of two parts, unstarred assignments, which will be graded for completion, and starred assignments which will receive feedback for revision and are eligible to be include in the final portfolio.  Each student needs to submit 5 unstarred or starred problems and 3 starred problems.
